description: Implement reschedule and cancel for a scheduled booking, with the API endpoints to trigger them. Reschedule: move the Session time, update the Google Calendar event, cancel the old reminder jobs and enqueue new ones for the new time, and send an update message. Cancel: mark the booking CANCELLED, delete the Calendar event, cancel reminder jobs, notify the customer, and handle refund per policy (flag the payment needsRefund when money was captured). This satisfies the Phase 5 'Done when: a rescheduled booking sends only the new reminders'. Depends on FEAT-002 (google update/delete + messaging) and FEAT-003 (reminder enqueue/cancel helpers).
steps: Create lib/booking-actions.ts (business-logic layer, mirror lib/meeting.ts structure and DI pattern) with rescheduleBooking(bookingId, newStartTime, overrides?) and cancelBooking(bookingId, reason?, overrides?). Both re-read the latest booking at run time and are idempotent.

rescheduleBooking: load booking with session->service->influencer; only allow when status is SCHEDULED or PAID (reject others with a typed error). Validate newStartTime is a real slot via isSlotStart (lib/slots.ts) and in the future, and that the target seat is free (reuse the session FOR UPDATE + activeSeatWhere capacity check pattern from lib/holds.ts, inside a prisma.$transaction). Move the booking to a Session at newStartTime (find-or-create the session like createHold's idempotent INSERT ... ON CONFLICT, computing endTime from service.durationMin). If the booking has an eventId, call deps.google.updateEvent to shift the calendar event start/end (refresh the influencer access token via getRefreshToken like lib/meeting.ts; handle GoogleReconnect/Request/Transient the same way). Then cancelReminders(bookingId) + enqueueReminders(bookingId, newStartTime) so ONLY the new reminders remain (the spec's key outcome). Enqueue an update message (template `reschedule`) via the messaging layer. Record lastError on failure; clear it on success.

cancelBooking: load booking; if already CANCELLED/EXPIRED/COMPLETED/FAILED, return idempotently. Set status CANCELLED. If eventId present, call deps.google.deleteEvent (treat already-gone as success). cancelReminders(bookingId) to drop pending reminders. Send a cancellation message (template `cancellation`) to the customer via the messaging layer. Refund policy: if a Payment for this booking is CAPTURED, set payment.needsRefund = true with a failureReason like 'booking cancelled' (mirror the needsRefund usage in lib/payment-webhook.ts) - actual money movement is out of scope and documented as a TODO. Do all DB mutations in a transaction.

Add typed errors (e.g. BookingActionError / BookingNotReschedulableError) in lib/booking-actions.ts following the MeetingBlockedError/MeetingRejectedError convention, so API routes can map them to 409/400.

Add API routes to trigger these. Create app/api/bookings/[id]/reschedule/route.ts (POST { startTime }) and app/api/bookings/[id]/cancel/route.ts (POST { reason? }), following the zod-validation + NextResponse pattern in app/api/bookings/hold/route.ts and the ctx.params Promise pattern in app/api/bookings/[id]/route.ts. Validate the body with zod, call the lib/booking-actions functions, map typed domain errors to 409/400 and success to 200 with the updated status. (If authentication is a concern, note in a comment that Phase 6 dashboard adds auth; keep parity with the existing unauthenticated routes.)

Add tests/booking-actions.test.ts (node:test). Pure-logic/injected-deps coverage: reschedule calls google.updateEvent, then cancelReminders followed by enqueueReminders with the NEW startTime (assert order and that the new delays correspond to the new time - proves 'only the new reminders'); reschedule of a non-SCHEDULED/PAID booking throws the typed error; cancel calls google.deleteEvent, cancelReminders, sends a cancellation message, and flags a CAPTURED payment needsRefund; cancel is idempotent on an already-CANCELLED booking (no second delete/alert). Use fake google client + fake queue helpers + DB-skip guard where a real row is needed (match payments.test.ts).
acceptance_criteria: lib/booking-actions.ts exports rescheduleBooking and cancelBooking, both re-reading booking state at run time and idempotent
rescheduleBooking updates the Calendar event, cancels old reminders and enqueues new ones for the new time, and sends an update message
cancelBooking deletes the Calendar event, cancels reminders, sends a cancellation message, marks CANCELLED, and flags a captured payment needsRefund
app/api/bookings/[id]/reschedule/route.ts and app/api/bookings/[id]/cancel/route.ts exist, validate input with zod, and map domain errors to 4xx
tests/booking-actions.test.ts proves reschedule results in only the new reminders (old cancelled, new enqueued with new delays) and that cancel is idempotent
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck lib/booking-actions.ts app/api/bookings/[id]/reschedule/route.ts app/api/bookings/[id]/cancel/route.ts` and confirm no real errors (unresolved '@/...'/'next'/'zod'/'@/generated/prisma' are environment noise). Fix every real error.

Read lib/booking-actions.ts and confirm reschedule calls cancelReminders BEFORE enqueueReminders(newStartTime), and that both reschedule and cancel load the booking fresh and short-circuit on terminal statuses.
Read the API routes and confirm zod validation + typed-error-to-4xx mapping mirrors app/api/bookings/hold/route.ts.
NOTE for CI (cannot run here): `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` must pass after install + prisma generate.
findings: Implemented reschedule + cancel on top of FEAT-002 (google updateEvent/deleteEvent + sendMessageForBooking) and FEAT-003 (cancelReminders/enqueueReminders). lib/booking-actions.ts mirrors lib/meeting.ts DI: BookingActionDeps { google, getRefreshToken, cancelReminders, enqueueReminders, sendMessage, alert } with defaultDeps wiring the real implementations; both functions re-read the booking fresh via prisma at run time and are idempotent. Typed errors: BookingNotReschedulableError (wrong/terminal state or missing booking -> 409/404) and BookingActionError (bad target time: past or not a real slot -> 400), following the MeetingBlockedError/MeetingRejectedError convention. rescheduleBooking(bookingId, newStartTime, overrides?): allows only SCHEDULED/PAID; validates newStartTime is in the future and isSlotStart(influencer.rules, service.durationMin); no-ops if already on that slot; inside prisma.$transaction it idempotently INSERT ... ON CONFLICT the target session (service_id, start_time), SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locks it, runs the activeSeatWhere capacity check (excluding this booking) exactly like lib/holds.ts createHold, then moves the booking's sessionId; if eventId present it refreshes the influencer token via getRefreshToken and calls google.updateEvent({start,end}) with the same GoogleReconnect(markReconnectNeeded+alert once)/GoogleRequest/GoogleTransient handling + booking.lastError recording as lib/meeting.ts; then cancelReminders(bookingId) FOLLOWED BY enqueueReminders(bookingId, newStartTime) so only the new reminders remain; sends template `reschedule` via the messaging layer and clears lastError on success. cancelBooking(bookingId, reason?, overrides?): returns 'already-cancelled' without any second delete/alert when the booking is CANCELLED/EXPIRED/COMPLETED/FAILED (idempotent); otherwise sends the `cancellation` message BEFORE flipping status (sendMessageForBooking only sends for PAID/SCHEDULED/COMPLETED, so sending after the flip would be skipped), then in one transaction sets status CANCELLED + flags any CAPTURED Payment needsRefund=true with failureReason 'booking cancelled[: reason]' (mirrors lib/payment-webhook.ts; actual refund is a documented TODO(phase-6)); deletes the Calendar event (already-gone=success via the client) and cancelReminders. Routes: app/api/bookings/[id]/reschedule/route.ts (POST {startTime}, zod iso datetime) and app/api/bookings/[id]/cancel/route.ts (POST {reason?}) follow hold/route.ts zod + NextResponse and the ctx.params Promise pattern; map BookingActionError->400, BookingNotReschedulableError/GoogleReconnect/GoogleRequest/GoogleTransient->409 (404 for not found), success->200 with the updated status; both carry a comment that Phase 6 adds auth (parity with existing unauthenticated routes). tests/booking-actions.test.ts (node:test, injected google/queue/messaging fakes + DATABASE_URL skip guard like payments.test.ts, every-weekday UTC rules so any aligned 30-min slot validates): reschedule calls updateEvent then cancelReminders BEFORE enqueueReminders (asserts call-order indices) with enqueueReminders receiving the NEW startTime (proves only-the-new-reminders); reschedule of a CANCELLED booking throws BookingNotReschedulableError and touches nothing; cancel deletes the event + cancelReminders + sends `cancellation` + flags a CAPTURED payment needsRefund with 'booking cancelled'; cancel on an already-CANCELLED booking returns 'already-cancelled' with no delete/message/alert. VERIFICATION: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck lib/booking-actions.ts app/api/bookings/[id]/reschedule/route.ts app/api/bookings/[id]/cancel/route.ts tests/booking-actions.test.ts` (global TS 5.9.2) reports only TS2688 'cannot find type definition file' noise from the empty node_modules; zero errors reference the new files. `npm run typecheck`/`npm test` and Postgres/Redis could not run here (npm registry blocked, no services); CI must run them after install + prisma generate.
